preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10.
The number of practice matches N for each test case must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= gi <= 1000000 for gi in goals)
preconditions.description: Each goal count gi must be between 0 and 1,000,000.

postconditions.description: The output must be the maximum goal difference if improvement is possible.
The output must be 'UNFIT' if no improvement is possible.
